sites.downstream: response.content[0].text -> strip() -> simple_classify(X) string return; no repository consumers or additional wrappers
sites.reason: Ten enumerated insurance support labels. Benign fixtures are eligible; arbitrary customer input has no effective injection mitigation. No exposed usage/finish diagnostics.

options.benefit: Accept confident ten-label decisions without generative inference; expected lower cost and latency on accepted inputs. Expected cost = Jev cost + fallback fraction * original cost.
options.risk: Confident errors, especially inquiries versus disputes; serial fallback adds cost and latency; only benign distribution assessed.

options.benefit: Preserves current behavior without migration risk or speculative savings.
options.risk: Retains original inference expense and prompt parsing.
